fact: The Max Planck Research Partner Group of the Université numérique Cheikh Hamidou Kane, whose research agenda is the regulation of the digital economy, held a conference-workshop in March 2022 on data governance and published a report on the Senegalese regulatory framework for data access and sharing.
title: Le rapport de la conférence-atelier 2022 du Max Planck Research Partner Group de l'UN-CHK disponible
